scope: OVERDOSE span-complement slot control; no extraction or candidate generation

decision.reason: Untouched/remainder OVERDOSE slots produce expected layout fragments because each complement keeps five or six of the eight letters, but p75 controls also produce layout hits and no checked source witness names an unused/remainder slot rule.
decision.nextMove: Keep span-complement slots as a visual-artifact control. Reopen extraction only with distinct source-backed wording that names untouched, remaining, unused, or remainder letters.
